name: Cache Lack Time Series Analysis
desc: Advanced undergraduate time series lecture series from Cache Lack Math & Stats Lectures covering noise processes, autocovariance and autocorrelation, smoothing, AR, MA, ARMA and ARIMA models, stationarity, ACF and PACF, estimation and forecasting, Durbin-Levinson and innovations algorithms, seasonal ARIMA, spectral density estimation, exponential smoothing, and GARCH processes, with applications in R.
